name: google-cloud-solution-agentic-ai-borderless-data-lakehouse
description: Guides agents to discover requirements and design a governed, secure borderless open data lakehouse with agentic AI integration. Use when designing a multi-product architecture that connects data silos to AI agents, joining data across clouds, or running federated queries across Google Cloud and external data sources, including on-premises or other cloud providers. Don't use for simple single-cloud data warehouses or non-AI workloads.
